correctness.rationale: The probability-sphere normalization gives n U_ell, with diagonal n^2. The inner-product values on and across the two orbits give the signed coefficients n epsilon and n sqrt(2) eta. One can verify the incidence algebra without a numerical spectrum: form the 12-by-4 matrices A and C of short and long representatives. Both have transpose times themselves 3I_4, by cancellation of mixed terms and the coordinate multiplicities. Then S=2(AA^T-I), T=2(CC^T-I), and B=sqrt(2) AC^T, giving all the stated identities by multiplication. Their complementary eight-dimensional sectors have eigenvalue n(n-2 epsilon) each, and the two four-dimensional frame ranges couple with singular value sqrt(18) for B, giving the two stated eigenvalues of multiplicity four. At n=2,4,6,8,10 the ranks are 4,16,20,24,20; for n>=12 the smallest bracket is at least n-10>0. Equality of the three sectors implies eta=epsilon=0, i.e. 4 and 3 both divide even n. Flipping representatives conjugates by a diagonal sign matrix. The pseudoinverse interpolation statement follows from G=EE*, including its singular cases. An independent exact coordinate reconstruction verified the signed identities and low-degree ranks.
residual_risks: No inference about even degrees, non-probability normalization, spanning the ambient harmonic space, or arbitrary configurations.

Suter does not phrase the result as harmonic interpolation on lines; the objection is a demonstrated prior implication, not an assertion that the exact interpolation wording is already printed. The change to 24 antipodal representatives is a scalar normalization on the odd block. The rank exceptions, positivity threshold and orthogonality class then follow by inspection. No new spectral information beyond this implication is established by the bound claim.
residual_risks: No searched source was shown to print the identical 24-line spectral statement verbatim. The verdict depends on exact mechanical implication from the earlier character and branching data, not on a conjecture about an unlocated publication or on the dates of the catalogue items.

value.rationale: The root-line sampling question is well motivated and the coordinate proof is useful exposition. However, the proposed scientific contribution is an exact invariant already mechanically determined by established data: the rank exceptions are zero-multiplicity sectors, the orthogonality progression is equality of three tabulated-character expressions, and minimum-norm recovery is the usual pseudoinverse formula. None provides an independently new classification or a motivated further invariant beyond the prior implication. This is not a rejection for working with a finite configuration.
residual_risks: No broader claim about other groups or even degrees was evaluated; the result can still be pedagogically useful as a geometric derivation.
